itinerary.notes:
Base: Zurich

Activities: • Check-out
• Train to Zurich Airport
• Airport roaming / dinner before flight

Transport: Train Interlaken > Zurich Airport (~2h)

Notes: Flight departure 22:00

Base: Wilderswil

Activities: • 10AM paragliding
• Explore Interlaken town
• Train to Grindelwald
• Gondola to First
• First Cliff Walk

Transport: Train Interlaken > Grindelwald (~35min)

Notes: Best combo alpine activity day

Base: Wilderswil

Activities: • Train to Kandersteg
• Cable car up mountain
• Scenic lake walk
• Picnic by the water
• Optional rowing boat

Transport: Train Interlaken > Kandersteg (~1h20)

Notes: One of Switzerland’s most beautiful lakes

Base: Wilderswil — Jungfrau Hotel

Activities: • Scenic train journey to Interlaken
• Hotel check-in
• Explore town centre
• Option A: Lauterbrunnen > Mürren hike
• Option B: Gschwandtenmaad Rosenlaui Valley
• Option C: Slow walk around Mürren village

Transport: Train Lausanne > Interlaken (~2h)

Notes: Travel + chill day

Base: Lausanne

Activities: • Explore Lausanne old town
• Train to Montreux
• Montreux promenade walk
• Visit Chillon Castle (optional)

Transport: Train Lausanne > Montreux (~45min)

Notes: Short relaxed scenic day

Base: Lausanne

Activities: • Early train via Visp
• Explore Zermatt village
• View Matterhorn
• Optional Gornergrat railway viewpoint
• Hike from Gornergrat to Riffelberg
• Blue hour photography at Kirchbrücke bridge

Transport: Train Lausanne > Zermatt (~2h15 each way)

Notes: Optional Gornergrat Railway (~CHF66 round trip with Half Fare)

Base: Lausanne

Activities: • Walk UNESCO old town streets
• Zytglogge clock tower
• Rose Garden viewpoint
• Riverside walk along Aare river
• Bear Park

Transport: Train Lausanne > Bern (~1h15)

Notes: Bern pinned map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Gng5hzTMzm6AH6XT6

Base: Lausanne — Swiss Chocolate by Fassbind Lausanne

Activities: • Arrive Zurich 13:20
• Train to Lausanne
• Hotel check-in
• Evening walk along Ouchy promenade by Lake Geneva

Transport: Train Zurich Airport > Lausanne (~2h10)

Notes: Buy point-to-point ticket Zurich Airport > Lausanne
